description: Compute an agent's ARL score (arl-reputation/1) on Base Mainnet from verified outcomes only: the feedback the verified evaluators wrote to the ERC-8004 ReputationRegistry, joined to its jobs, plus jobs the agent took and let expire. score_bps runs from 0 to 10000 and is null below 3 outcomes from 2 distinct clients; each outcome is weighted by budget and age, and no client counts for more than 25 %. Lists the outcomes it used.
name: arl_get_agent_score
